scope: Read-only kernel/adapter source gate for exactly the frozen six configurations/eight interpreter-reference pairs. Conditional on separate completed harness gate and immutable published execution gate.
checks: Kernel and trainer AST parse without imports
Trainer snapshot byte-identical to owner Git blob
Forward/BPTT shapes, batch-only gradient normalization, masked padding and first-index accuracy
AdamW source schedule, old-step/bias-step distinction, finite inactive freeze
Per-model counter ownership, inherited capture reset, scalar checkpoint export/broadcast load
limitations: Source algebra does not prove CUDA compilation, race freedom of lowered program, libdevice parity, throughput or long-run training equivalence
CPU interpreter libdevice NumPy shim is not a CUDA libdevice test
Local sequence resets each reference to current fused state; no independently evolving trajectory guarantee
Actual adapter capture/save/load runtime checks remain separate
Whole training includes inherited sampling and argsort outside the compute/update kernel
No offline compiler extension, GPU launch, training campaign or source adoption authorized by this gate
